dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with a high-degree spline curvature transitioning from a sharp apex to a wide posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small pixel radius; classifies as rounded-acute.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 52 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical height to maximum horizontal base width ratio of approximately 0.85:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex melon arc with a smooth, medium-radius curvature visible between the blowhole and the rostrum inflection.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum with a visible protrusion at the anterior-most point, characterized by high thickness-to-length ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Approximately 140 degrees at the visible pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the dorsal plane of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of distinct, parallel vertical rake marks are visible on the mid-lateral flank; a prominent depigmented white patch is present on the apex of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced counter-shading with a dark-pigmented dorsal cape and peduncle region contrasting against a lighter blue-grey lateral field.
